TARU-Net CIPS-Net ECG-Free Echo CXR-LT Lung Digital Twin

Lung Digital Twin

Wearable Biosignals for Real-Time Respiratory Monitoring

This project investigates how wearable biosignals can be used to build a digital twin of the lung for real-time respiratory monitoring. The focus is on turning continuous physiological signals into actionable health insight.

The page can later host the paper summary, methodology, and results, but even now it should explain the project clearly enough for search engines and visitors to understand the topic.
